text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing, we passed 
by the park where the neighborhood bully 
used to hang out... but she was nowhere to 
be seen.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, she's not here today either, is she? 
I haven't seen her around lately at all.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I do worry whether she's bedridden from 
overeating, or if she pulled a muscle 
practicing Precure transformation 
scenes...

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text:
...If you mean the boss, they aren't 
coming anymore.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text: —Because I'm moving away.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? M-Moving!? I haven't heard anything 
about this, you know!?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text:
I think so too... She told her other 
friends not to come see her off either...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: —I simply cannot accept such a thing!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
No matter how painful it is, leaving 
without a proper farewell... isn't like a 
princess at all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me! Where is that child's 
house!?

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text:
W-We're not gonna make it in time! They 
said they're leaving this evening—

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even if she's already left... As a 
princess, I will definitely catch up to 
her!

Though I rushed to the house the child 
told me about, ...the car had already 
left.

text_block_list.name: Former Timid Brat
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... No good, I was too slow!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"—No! We made it in time! I saw a familiar 
baseball cap in the back seat of that car 
driving away!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A mere car is a piece of cake for the 
Princess! Oryaaaaaaaah!!

Kawakami Princess dashed forward at full 
speed, rapidly catching up to the car—!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, please waaaaaiiiiit!! For 
meeeeeeeeeeee!!

—After matching its speed perfectly and 
appealing furiously alongside it, the car 
finally came to a stop.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
――I understand. You felt lonely, didn't 
you? Being apart from you is just as 
painful for me, after all...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Still! Just vanishing without even saying 
a proper goodbye is simply running away 
from an unpleasant reality!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That is not befitting of a princess! If 
you run away here, what will you do once 
you move?!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: Sis...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...Even a princess must sometimes face 
painful, unwanted, and sorrowful 
realities. Just like today—"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Even so, we'll charge in with all our 
might and carve a path! That's what the 
princess spirit is all about!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
――One thing! Please make a promise to me. 
That wherever you move to, you will face 
every hardship with all your might.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
That won't be a problem at all! I'm sure 
you'll make tons of new friends again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text: ...*sniff*...! Yeah...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
If you ever feel like giving up anyway— 
just watch our races on TV. I'll remind 
you what a true princess looks like!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
I'll watch... I'll definitely watch! Big 
Sis... we will...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume in a Baseball Cap
text_block_list.text:
We'll always be friendsâforever and 
everâ!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
What?! We are besties, Pre-pals, bosom 
friends!

—And so, the car drove away. Watching it 
leave, Kawakami Princess had a gentle 
expression on her face—

—For a brief moment, it showed on the face 
of Precure, who proudly continues to fight 
to protect the peace.
